notes.title: Update 13
notes.notes:
Today, the new update has been released! I'm happy to announce that the full update features 40 new room layouts, which doubles the amount of room layouts that have been in the game so far. 
On top of that, I've overhauled the Trinkets menu, which should be much easier and nicer to view and use. Additionally, the character menu was also updated to have better visibility and comfort. Plus a bunch of other quality of life changes and additions like a new Totem and other things that you have to find yourselves.

This is my thank you to the community that has been supporting me through the years. Have fun!

notes.title: A special thanks to the UNLOVED community (new and old)
notes.notes:
A very big thank you to the UNLOVED community! (new and old)

I've gone through two very chaotic years, fueled by weed and alcohol, living the "Lebowski" lifestyle. White Russians and "magic cookies" for breakfast, lunch and dinner, all day long, every day.

Slowly but surely I've drifted into complete madness, living in exile, even blocking all my windows with newspapers. I was done with humanity.

Sometimes, I ate way too many cookies and drank heavily and went into the bathtub, not knowing if I would finally drift off and not wake up anymore. I didn't even care. Somehow, I must have had some kind of protection, because (and sometimes to my dismay) I always woke up again. I've also done some very questionable things, lived my life fully unhinged, not caring about anything, anyone or even myself.

Eventually, I've started having mental breakdowns. I've had so many, that I could feel them coming like a sneeze. And ultimately, I even started enjoying them. I learned to enjoy living at "rock bottom".

Without even knowing, I must have gone through a major depression that probably lasted longer than I care to remember.

The final straw happened a few weeks ago, when I was certain I would not survive my binge. My chest tightened and I got some of the worst panic attacks of my life. All in one evening. I've had the worst case of "nightmare trip" imaginable. It was hell.

After a few days of calming down from that trip, I've thrown all of my weed out and threw all alcohol away. No more "Lebowski".

Since then (and with the colossal help of the event that currently happened), I've ripped down all the newspapers and added some new furniture into my tiny apartment to make it a lot brighter, add vibrant colors and I am currently starting to enjoy life again without any substances.

So, if anyone out there is going through some tough times as well - all I'll say is do whatever your heart tells you. Somehow, you'll find your way. If a Fool like me can go through hell and come out on the other side, so can everybody else.

Anyway, long story short - I've recently started working on a new update for UNLOVED!

And believe you me, I will add a bunch more memories that may or may not be based on my experiences through that very chaotic time.

Thank you all from the bottom of my heart!

And finally a special notice to our new Japanese community (I see you):
日本の皆様、ようこそお越しいただきありがとうございます！私が初めて偉大な巨匠である宮本茂先生の作品をプレイした時から、ビデオゲームへの愛が芽生えましたので、皆様をお迎えできることは、特別な喜びです。心から光栄に思い、私の作品をお楽しみいただければ幸いです。ありがとうございます。

notes.notes:

Since Steam is pretty much hiding Early Access games, Dimension Drifter sold almost nothing and made me almost go out of business. I had two options: rush Dimension Drifter out the door as fast as possible or make an entirely new game. Since I have a lot of awesome features planned for Dimension Drifter that I didn't want to scrap, I ended up with option 2 - make a new game set in the Dimension Drifter Universe. This way, I can expand the world and when I come back to DD, I can add all kinds of awesome stuff that I have come up with in the meantime.

Like with all my games, I've put a lot of love and care into this one and I hope you're not mad with me - again, Steam visibility of indie titles has been very poor in the past 2 years now - and hopefully you're excited to see this game flourish on Steam so I can stay in business :)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mYl9lPFWqSA

Dimension Drifter is a fast paced, ultra-violent action shooter with a non-linear storyline.

Our timeline has collapsed and many didn't even notice. Since then, inexplicable mysteries started happening all over the world. Strange sightings of objects and beings. Crop circles appeared. Cattle mutilation. Memories that didn't reflect reality anymore. The list gets longer every day...

All of this was just the beginning. Since then, hundreds of years have passed. It all spiraled out of control. One day, strange portals to another dimension have opened and Demons poured out. An endless war began. Some cities have created plasma domes around them, protecting them from the eternal onslaught. But most now lie in ruins.

Some extraordinary people who were able to survive long enough in the ruins have harnessed special abilities. In the eye of the public, these powers are deemed evil and it is said they are of demonic nature. These special people are outcasts, not allowed to enter the Domes of safety anymore. They are called Drifters.

notes.title: ABYSS Update is Live!
notes.notes:
ːheptagramredː[b]Enter the Abyss![/b]
Once a player reaches level 150, the Abyss difficulty will open. On the Abyss Difficulty, the toughest Challengers in UNLOVED await the player - the Abyss Wanderers. Only those who manage to survive 3 Abyss Wanderers in a single map will be rewarded with a new treasure... a legendary Abyss Chest! What do they contain?

ːheptagramredː[b]Abyss Chests and Rank 4 Trinkets![/b]
If a player manages to open an Abyss Chest, they will be rewarded with a new Rank 4 Trinket. These Trinkets all start with level 1 and have to be upgraded by using Abyss Coins. To get Abyss Coins, a player can break an Abyss Chest, Demon Chest or a Ring.

ːheptagramredː[b]New Enemies: Abyss Wanderers[/b]
The Abyss Wanderers are the toughest enemies in UNLOVED so far. They only appear when playing on Abyss difficulty and they come with unique abilities that will turn enemies around them into raging nightmares. Your chances of survival will drop by the second, so once an Abyss Wanderer has come to your realm, make sure to be prepared for a real battle and kill it as fast as you can.

Additional fixes and balance changes have been made as well. To read the full changelog, go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/1480982338946643162/

notes.title: New Update: Of Angels and Chaos
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953823/296004edfce3d08918666ba8117454a4aa215e8a.jpg[/img]

This new update brings a couple of new features and improvements to UNLOVED!

Two new Totems can now be found: the Amulet of Chaos which gives a chance to turn enemies insane when they see you. Insane enemies will simply attack anything on sight, even their own kin!

The other new Totem is the Amulet of Heavens. This item gives you the possibility to find a Guardian Angel! These special demons will become your ally when they see you. Guardian Angels will follow you and protect you from other demons!

I've also added a new feature to highlight objects and enemies - which is especially useful for multiplayer games. It writes down a small notice in pink that other players can read and it gives the object an outline for 5 seconds. For some players this option is turned off by default. To enable it, go to controls and hit 'reset' - this should show the last entry called 'highlight'. Now you can assign a new key for it if you want.

There are also some improvements to enemy AI, menus, balance and more :)

To read the full changelog, go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/224446614468375054/

notes.title: BASEMENT UPGRADE RELEASED!
notes.notes:
First off: A huge THANK YOU to the community who is giving so much feedback and input for UNLOVED and help me greatly to improve this game! Thank you very much, I love working on this game and it wouldn't be possible without your support! :)

Today the largest Upgrade of UNLOVED has been released: The Basement Upgrade! Here are some of the new features:

ːheptagramredː [b]New Area: THE BASEMENT[/b]
A new area has been added to the game which is heavily inspired by the original Doom2 Mod. It is the most horrifying location yet. With large underground graveyards and cramped endless corridors, it is the most dangerous of places and therfore not allowed to players below level 13! This new area comes with 4 new music tracks made for UNLOVED by James Dean.

ːheptagramredː [b]New Enemy: THE WITCH[/b]
The Witch is the most vile creature in UNLOVED so far. She is very fast and deadly. She comes with the ability to summon other Demons to aid her against her enemies in combat. She can also kill you just by looking at you.

ːheptagramredː [b]New Trinkets: RANK 3 TRINKETS[/b]
When you play on Beast Mode difficulty, there is now a Demon Lockbox that spawns in the level. Once you unlock it and complete the map, you get a Demon Chest. This chest can be unlocked to reveal one of 25 Rank 3 Trinkets. These Trinkets are the most powerful in the game and have more variety on their stats to give more flexibility for specific builds. Rank 3 are the only Trinkets that can have a maximum level of 7.

ːheptagramredː [b]New Feature: Enemy Infighting[/b]
Demons are wild and chaotic beings. Their evil nature will now also cause them to attack each other if a fireball happens to hit another Demon. However, Witches will never be targeted by other Demons, except there is nothing else to fight anymore.

ːheptagramredː [b]Overhauled Game Pacing[/b]
The pacing of the game has been rebalanced to be more curve-like and dramatic. In the beginning, enemy spawns are lower than before - and the more you progress through the map, enemy spawns will increase. This gives a much more intense overall gameplay and gives a better feel of progression throughout a map.

And many, many more upgrades, fixes and tweaks...

To read all the changes of this upgrade, you can go here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/412449508291471127/

notes.title: Price policy changed!
notes.notes:
From now on, the price of UNLOVED has been reduced back to its original value and it will stay down, even when the full (non Early Access) version launches!

When I released the game in Early Access, I thought it would be fair to increase the price over time as new content gets added to the game to represent this added value. But I feel that ultimately this might not be the best course to grow a community for a multiplayer game - as a higher price might scare potential players rather than welcome everyone on board no matter when they find out about the game.

So from now on UNLOVED's price has been reduced back to the initial launch price and it will stay that way :)

notes.title: Updated Spawn Mechanics and more...
notes.notes:
In the recent update, I've added a new feature to the enemy spawn system to make it feel much more "designed". Whenever enemies spawn, there is now a chance that the game will spawn a whole group of enemies at the same place, instead of just spawning one individual enemy and then spawn the next one some place else.

This adds two new layers to the enemy encounters.

1. Enemy encounters feel much more "designed". Every enemy group is hand picked and has enemies that compliment eachother. Sometimes a group can consist of just three Cutters or two Butchers. Some other groups are mixed of different enemy types, for example two Nurses and a Doctor. This greatly increases the chance of opening a door, just to see a whole room filled with Cutters... or Clowns.

2. Certain enemy types are now much more dangerous, because they can come in great numbers at once, instead of being spread all over the map. Having a group of 10 Cutters chase you down can easily cause you a quick death, making even the weakest opponents much more dangerous now.

Besides the enemy spawn changes, the new update also comes with improvements to the player model, animation changes and much more.

Tell me what you think :)

To read the full changelog, head over here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/412446890554857491/

notes.title: Magnum Power + Netcode improvements
notes.notes:
In the recent update, I've gone through more community suggetions to improve the game and add a new layer of polish.

First off, there is now a new silver look to the Pistol after you equip the Magnum Mod. The Magnum Mod also has a different way of calculating damage than before. Now, the Magnum damage gets applied seperately of any other damage mod, meaning that every additional damage increases the already very high Magnum damage, giving you greater benefits.

Also if you join a multiplayer game now, you will be spawned at the location of the host instead of the normal starting room. This gives you lots of advantages and also lets new players instantly join the fun instead of run around to find the host and in the worst case get killed on the way.

Additionally I've updated the netcode and improved bandwidth usage to give you all a smoother experience :)

For the full changelog, go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/458605613393540616/

notes.notes:
Another update has arrived. This time I have added new gameplay changing effects that you can pick up by collecting one of the new Totems.

Tactical Goggles:
Picking up this Totem gives you the ability to see enemies on your minimap within a certain range. This can completely change the perspective you have on the game and can give you a completely new tactical advantage.

Vampire Tooth:
This item gives your melee attacks the addition of life leech. Another gameplay changer, because whenever you're low on health, instead of picking up an item, you can instead choose to leech your health back from enemies using your Kukri.

Ghost Ammo:
There are now three ghost ammo Totems in the game, giving you a chance to reload your weapon without reducing the total ammo you have.

There are also some other changes and fixes in this update and if you want to read the full change list, you can do that over here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/494631967660496075/

notes.title: Update! Visuals got significant update, more Trinkets and Totems!
notes.notes:
With this update I've added two major new features. 

First off, UNLOVED now has fully dynamic Ambient Occlusion which gives the whole game a new improved look. Using AO in modern games is nothing new, but in UNLOVED this task was something special - because AO is not designed for dynamic environments like in this game, so it was a little bit tricky to get it to work - but now it revamps the whole game and gives everything a better sense of depth!

Second, the Trinket Manager got an overhaul and also 4 new Trinket slots, 14 new Trinkets and 3 new Totems have been added to the game. This gives you much more options to customize your gear towards the playstyle you prefer.

It's now also much easier to upgrade existing Trinkets with the use of Fragments. You can break Trinkets you don't like into Fragments and use them to upgrade the Trinkets you do like. You can also break Ink Bottles into Fragments to upgrade your Trinkets. It's now also much easier to get higher rank Trinkets by completing a level.

Read the full change log here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/492378265880903283/

First off, UNLOVED now has fully dynamic Ambient Occlusion which gives the whole game a new improved look. Using AO in modern games is nothing new, but in UNLOVED this task was something special - because AO is not designed for dynamic environments like in this game, so it was a little bit tricky to get it to work - but now it revamps the whole game and gives everything a better sense of depth!

Second, the Trinket Manager got an overhaul and also 4 new Trinket slots, 14 new Trinkets and 3 new Totems have been added to the game. This gives you much more options to customize your gear towards the playstyle you prefer.

It's now also much easier to upgrade existing Trinkets with the use of Fragments. You can break Trinkets you don't like into Fragments and use them to upgrade the Trinkets you do like. You can also break Ink Bottles into Fragments to upgrade your Trinkets. It's now also much easier to get higher rank Trinkets by completing a level.

Read the full change log here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/492378265880903283/

notes.title: New Content Released: Clinic Upgrade!
notes.notes:
Today, new content has been added to UNLOVED. Get chased through haunted hospital corridors by demonic nurses and don't miss your appointment with the lobotomized doctor!

Watch the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=56Kd7zj4cuE

The content includes:
[b]A Total of Four New Enemies[/b]
First, there is the Demon Nurse. She will viciously chase you down to cut you up with her gigantic scalpel. Then there is the Lobotomized Doctor. He is a terrifying hulking abomination that has done several experiments on himself and now he's looking for new specimens. Both enemy types have an alternate version, effectively increasing the enemy roster by 4 in total.

[b]New Weapon[/b]
The Silenced Machine Pistol is your new tool in the arsenal. It comes with its own new Weapon Mods and with its high rate of fire it is a great addition to your loadout. The silenced gunsounds also make enemies uncapable of detecting you when you shoot, so it is another strategic element that you can utilize to survive.

[b]New Area[/b]
A whole new set of unique room layouts have been designed. Hunt or be hunted in endless hospital corridors, disgusting operation theaters, twisted x-ray stations or creepy, candlelit bedrooms full of grotesque monstrosities. This new area also features new music specifically composed to fit the atmosphere perfectly by James Dean!

[b]New Trinkets and Achievements[/b]
New Trinkets have been added to the game to give you a greater choice to plan your strategy and finetune your play-style. Also new Steam Achievements have been added for the new weapon and monsters (and a few extra ones). 

[b]Many new and updated features, requested by YOU, the community![/b]
I'm reading your comments every day, trying to improve the game as best as I can. With the Clinic Upgrade, new requested features have made it into the game that will improve your enjoyment and enhance your experience with UNLOVED!

Read the full patch notes here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/487870763313800215/
